'''Nerran''' was a young [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. He was gunned down and killed in the mining complex during the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]].
